plugin.name: Commerce PayPal
plugin.description: PayPal payment gateway for GoPress Commerce with Orders v2, sandbox and live modes, webhook signature verification, and refunds. This opt-in satellite depends only on the Core Commerce contracts.
plugin.settings.title: %s - Plugin Settings
plugin.paypal.settings.payment_help: When enabled and fully configured, PayPal appears among the checkout payment methods.
plugin.paypal.settings.secret_configured: Configured; leave blank to keep unchanged
plugin.paypal.settings.webhook_id_help: Enter the Webhook ID created in the PayPal developer dashboard so callbacks can be verified.
plugin.paypal.settings.webhook_help: Add this URL as a Webhook in the PayPal developer dashboard and subscribe to CHECKOUT.ORDER.APPROVED, PAYMENT.CAPTURE.COMPLETED, PAYMENT.CAPTURE.REFUNDED, and PAYMENT.CAPTURE.DENIED.
plugin.paypal.settings.ready: Configuration complete. PayPal will appear at checkout.
plugin.paypal.settings.not_ready: Enable PayPal and provide a Client ID and Client Secret before it can appear at checkout.
